formal_object.rationale: Train covariance is PSD with mu>0; fixed alpha and ridge define the actual transform.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: A05: Shrink toward isotropy before inverse-root whitening. Condition: C PSD and mu>0 D05: lambda_min(C_alpha)>=(alpha mu+rho). Condition: alpha>0,rho>0

derivation.rationale: Shared identity terms yield exact eigenvalue and inverse-root amplification bounds; neither gives an accuracy theorem.

assumptions.rationale: Covariance is centered on training inputs; evaluate with the same fixed means/maps. The shared diagonal shift bounds inverse amplification; it need not improve downstream ranking. Fixed alpha=.2 is not an estimated Ledoit-Wolf or OAS optimum. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: A finite fixed-alpha inverse-root map is explicit; legacy floor/ridge must be matched in every whitening comparison.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Unstable small empirical eigenvalues cause less amplification under shrinkage; any useful benefit must survive comparison with ordinary ridge and fitted covariance shrinkage. Falsification: Same-ridge whitening, diagonal scaling, OAS or Ledoit-Wolf gives the same or better native tradeoff, or shrinkage removes informative rare directions.

closest_alternative.rationale: Ridge whitening, OAS and Ledoit-Wolf are known alternatives; fixed .2 does not claim their estimation optimum. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.

review_independence: Single-agent self-review; not a blinded/independent novelty or empirical review.
claim_scope: Conditional formal construction only. No code/test/design/result/native-parent qualification.
